risks.title: Cyberattacks and data security
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, with a dedicated committee (Audit Committee) and regular CISO reports. The language emphasizes emerging threats and active board oversight. Cybersecurity is highly critical for service companies. High weighting due to exposure to sensitive data and regulatory obligations.

risks.title: Multiple legal disputes
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions numerous potential disputes across various areas (employment, environment, compliance, etc.). While the company estimates none are individually material, the aggregated risk is significant. The language indicates that an adverse outcome could have a material impact, reflecting moderate to high severity.

risks.title: Complex regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: The risk covers numerous regulatory frameworks (data protection, health and safety, environment, anti-corruption, etc.). The text explicitly cites federal, state, and international laws, indicating broad exposure. Increasing regulatory complexity justifies high severity.

risks.title: Vulnerabilities related to personal data
risks.score_rationale: The risk is included in programs supervised by the CISO and Audit Committee, with explicit mention of data protection. Processing of sensitive data (health, employment, etc.) increases exposure. The language is preventive but acknowledges critical threats.

risks.title: Dependence on CISO governance
risks.score_rationale: The CISO plays a central role in strategy and incident response. While experience is highlighted (20 years, certifications), concentration of responsibilities presents a moderate risk if transition is poorly managed. The role is critical but institutional processes appear in place.

risks.title: Operational environmental risks
risks.score_rationale: Mention of past and current operations subject to environmental regulations, with discussions of informal settlements. The company estimates impact is not material, but risk exists, especially for sites from acquisitions. Language is cautious but not alarming.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence or machine learning was found in the text.
